title: Medicaid Crossover Payments on Oxygen Equipment Lines — Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility
content:
**Remittance posting card — Medicaid as payer of last resort on Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility accounts.**

## The policy

When a Medicaid Fee-for-Service record sits behind a primary coverage as the payer of last resort, every coinsurance charge the primary leaves on an oxygen claim line whose date of service falls on or after the Medicaid record's effective date receives the Medicaid crossover payment as one secondary-payment entry on the primary account, naming the charge it settles and carrying the Medicaid record as the paying coverage. The crossover follows automatically when the primary class crosses claims over automatically.

- **Deductible charges.** A deductible charge in that scope is paid by Medicaid under the coordination rule's deductible clause and is not priced here.
- **One line at a time.** Crossover remittances are posted one line at a time, starting from the newest oxygen line the primary adjudicated, and each settles the coinsurance charge that stems from its line.
- **Scope of this pricing.** For a Medicaid secondary's crossover on a coinsurance charge from an oxygen line, and only for such a crossover, the payment on the coinsurance charge is figured under this policy; every other secondary payment on a coinsurance charge remains under the base coordination rule.
- **Ceiling.** For a crossover this policy prices, and only for such a crossover, the payment is posted on the primary account against the coinsurance charge it settles, carrying the Medicaid record as the paying coverage, and never exceeds the line's cost share, any part above the charge's open amount staying on the account as a credit; every other secondary payment remains under the base rule and never exceeds the open amount of the charge it settles.
- **Charges Medicaid does not pay here.** Medicaid pays nothing under this policy on copay, non-covered-with-notice, upgrade-difference, self-pay, repair-patient-share or unreturned-equipment charges.

## Posting the payment: `post_crossover_payment_b661a2ed`

**Capability.** The tool posts a secondary payer's crossover payment against one patient charge on the primary coverage account — the amount a secondary coverage (such as a Medicaid record behind Medicare) pays on the patient's share of a claim line the primary payer adjudicated. One call writes one secondary-payment entry dated today on the primary account, naming the charge it settles and the secondary coverage that paid, carrying the claim line's allowed amount and origin from that charge, and lowers the primary account's patient balance by the amount. The patient sees the secondary payment under that charge on the account history.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `post_crossover_payment_b661a2ed` with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `coverage_id` | the reference number of the primary coverage account that carries the charge, as returned by the coverage lookup | identifier |
| `applied_to_entry_id` | the reference number of the patient charge entry the secondary payment settles, as returned by the patient-account ledger lookup for the primary account | identifier |
| `payer_coverage_id` | the reference number of the secondary coverage record that paid, as returned by the coverage lookup | identifier |
| `amount` | the secondary payment applied to the charge, in USD | a figure of zero or more with 2 decimal places; stored exactly as given, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A text rendering of a record with `secondary_payment_id` (the reference of the new entry), `coverage_id` (the primary account), `applied_to_entry_id` (the charge settled), `payer_coverage_id` (the secondary coverage that paid), `amount` (USD with 2 decimals), `posting_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD), `patient_balance` (the primary account balance once the payment is posted, USD with 2 decimals) and `status`, the string "posted". A receipt whose status is "posted" means the payment is on the account.

## Points of judgement

| Charge on the primary account | Under this policy |
|---|---|
| Coinsurance charge from an oxygen line with a date of service on or after the Medicaid effective date | receives the Medicaid crossover payment |
| Deductible charge from such a line | paid under the coordination rule's deductible clause, not priced here |
| Copay charge | Medicaid pays nothing under this policy |
| Coinsurance charge from a hospital bed line | outside this policy; the base coordination rule governs |
